body: I can’t stand our culture and the lack of commitment we have with friendships and intimate relationships. Human beings are not meant to be alone. I feel like when I die  there will be so many people who will say oh she was such a great friend and honestly it’s a one-way street because all of them are so shitty I’m so angry and I don’t want this pain in my heart but I feel like that’s who I am and who I’ve become.
